findings.identity_proportions: Neet retains a full narrow tan torso, long fine legs, neck, projecting cream muzzle, broad triangular ears and a tiny nub. Buddy has a compact folded full body with modest furnished head; the resting pose is read against B20 and frontal facial evidence, not used to infer standing ratios.
findings.connectivity_support_limb_ownership: Neet has four individually traceable leg shafts and grounded paws, paired behind the near limbs without an extra leg. Buddy head joins neck and curved torso; muzzle rests between two front paws while tucked haunches and curled tail remain supported by the broad chair cushion. No detached limb or floating body.
findings.grooming_finish: Neet body, neck and limbs are smooth color planes, with no engraved curls or shag silhouette. Buddy charcoal back and shoulder are broad smooth planes; strands remain locally in muzzle, brows, hanging ears and folded lower extremity/tail furnishing. Upholstery/carpet marks are material texture, not dog coat.
findings.state_setting_props_comedy: Airport apron and aircraft establish lounge context; food dishes and chafing station sit where Neet aims his nose. Buddy curls facing away from the buffet while Neet stands alert beside him. This captures their opposing priorities exactly before Heather leaves to shower. Furniture contact and room perspective are coherent.

findings.identity_proportions: Neet broad cupped ears, modest frontal head, dark eyes/nose, projecting cream muzzle and fine leg shafts preserve photographic identity. His torso and tail are substantially covered; the review does not infer hidden measurements.
findings.connectivity_support_limb_ownership: Four paw positions are visible: two rear paws behind, exposed near foreleg, and other forepaw at the hem beneath lifted cloth. The cloth-covered foreleg is occluded rather than an extra appendage. All paws meet the same tiled floor plane. Heather crouches with plausible bent legs, feet on floor, one hand gripping cloth and the other resting; no fused dog/human limb.
findings.grooming_finish: Face and exposed neck/legs have smooth short-coat color planes. Fine whiskers do not create a shaggy cheek or chest. White looped texture belongs to the terry towel and folds. No recurring directional engraved coat strokes remain.
findings.state_setting_props_comedy: Heather is fully dressed and lifting the towel away from the covered forepaw; Neet stiff dignified stare carries the luxury-trap gag. Opaque shower door is closed, towels are stacked beside them, and the private-room boundary remains intact. The exact inserted state precedes towel return. Human appearance is provisional.

findings.identity_proportions: Buddy has a continuous moderately long charcoal torso, visible neck/chest, substantial legs and clear space below his body; pale muzzle/brows and hanging ears preserve regional identity. Neet has a full narrow body, fine legs, broad ears, projecting muzzle and nub.
findings.connectivity_support_limb_ownership: Buddy four feet are supported on the cushion with limb roots and hind hocks readable. Near forefoot lies alongside the napkin rather than merging into it; far forefoot is behind it. Neet four legs connect to shoulders/pelvis and meet the carpet, neck extending upward toward the seat. No duplicated paws or disconnected rump.
findings.grooming_finish: Both torsos now use smooth broad tan or charcoal planes, visibly eliminating the prior engraved coat system seen in staging. Buddy beard, brows, ear fringes and small distal paw furnishings remain valid regional hair. Slight head/collar-edge strands do not expand into torso shag. Background textile grain does not alter canine contours.
findings.state_setting_props_comedy: Buddy stands above the newly exposed napkin on TOP of the cushion, two olives visible, while Neet approaches from floor before retrieval. Airport windows and seating support the layover setting. The reveal and Buddy tired glance make the unwilling-accomplice joke readable without repeating the lounge nap composition.
